dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago : Celebes _ South Coast. Buton Strait
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys between 1900 and 1917.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Shows depths, shoals, reefs, islands, peaks.
Ancillary chart 1. South Narrows ; Natural Scale 1:59,782 -- Ancillary chart 2. North Narrows ; Natural Scale 1:59,029
